intro.label: The most beautiful beaches of southern Sardinia
intro.paragrafo: Pula is the ideal base for exploring some of the most stunning coastlines in the Mediterranean. Nora, Chia, Tuerredda: masterpieces of nature just minutes away. And after a day at the beach, Villa Madau awaits you with a cool room, an aperitif and a dinner that tastes of Sardinia.

nora.alt: Nora Beach – Villa Madau Hotel, Pula
nora.testo: Three minutes from the hotel, one of the most evocative beaches in the Mediterranean opens up before you. Nora is a truly unique place: shallow, crystal-clear emerald waters, fine white sand, and behind you the ruins of an ancient Phoenician-Roman city emerging directly from the sea. You can swim out to the ruins, where the seabed reveals amphorae, mosaics and submerged columns. A place you won't forget.

chia.alt: Chia Beach – near Villa Madau Hotel, Pula
chia.testo: A fifteen-minute drive reveals the wild landscape of Chia: tall dunes covered with ancient juniper trees, shallow waters ideal for families, a lagoon with flamingos and herons. The beach of Su Giudeu, with its island reachable by wading, is among the most photographed in Sardinia. The mistral winds make it perfect for windsurfing too.

tuerredda.alt: Tuerredda Beach – near Villa Madau Hotel
tuerredda.testo: Twenty minutes and you arrive at what many consider the most beautiful beach in southern Sardinia. Tuerredda is a small bay enclosed between two rocky headlands, with Caribbean-coloured waters and an island just metres from the shore. The waters are crystal clear, the seabed slopes gently — ideal for snorkelling and swimming.

stacco.label: After the beach
stacco.testo: At the end of a day of sun and sea, there's nothing better than returning to your room — cool, quiet, with every comfort you need. An aperitif, a Sardinian dinner, and the rest you've earned.
